mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permission (id, code, service, name, group_name, realm, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{service}, #{name}, #{group}, #{realm}, 'active', now(), now(), NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (code) WHERE NOT deleted DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, group_name = EXCLUDED.group_name, realm = EXCLUDED.realm, status = 'active', updated_at = now(), updated_by = NULL WHERE permission.service = EXCLUDED.service
mapper.select: SELECT code FROM permission WHERE realm = #{realm} AND status = 'active' AND NOT deleted ORDER BY code
SELECT code, name, service, group_name AS "group" FROM permission WHERE realm = #{realm} AND status = 'active' AND NOT deleted ORDER BY service, group_name NULLS LAST, code
